record.issue_text: AddGuestsDialog.tsx dialog state is only reset by the Cancel button: closing via onOpenChange (overlay/Esc) leaves multiEmailValue and isInvalidEmail stale, and isInvalidEmail is never cleared when the user edits inputs or on success, so reopening shows stale emails and a lingering 'Emails must be unique and valid' banner

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, dialog open/close is controlled by `<Dialog open={isOpenDialog} onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}>`, but there is no effect/handler to reset `multiEmailValue` or `isInvalidEmail` when the dialog is closed via overlay click/Esc (i.e., through `onOpenChange`). Reset only happens on the Cancel button click (clears both) and partially on mutation success (clears `multiEmailValue` but does not clear `isInvalidEmail`). Also, `isInvalidEmail` is set to true on validation failure and is never cleared when the user edits `MultiEmail` inputs (`setMultiEmailValue` is called without resetting `isInvalidEmail`), so the error banner can persist after correcting input and/or across reopenings if the dialog was closed without pressing Cancel.
